item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine over southern China in the next few days. Winds will be weak and the weather will be persistently very hot over the region. However, showers triggered by high temperatures will affect the inland areas. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken gradually early to midweek next week. There will be a few showers over the coast of southern China.
